latency_policy.mode: offline file replay without real-time pacing
latency_policy.file_audio_to_readback_wall_ms: PCM read/convert, ASR, software metric/dispatch work, Voice/control/console feedback and explicit final Mock snapshot; excludes independent reference probe
latency_policy.decode_only_ms: nested inside ASR replay, excludes accept/resample
latency_policy.voice_control_feedback_wall_ms: Voice normalization, intent/Mock execution/immediate readback and synchronous console feedback
latency_policy.explicit_final_readback_wall_ms: final list_states snapshot of all Mock devices; additional per-execution get_state is recorded inside control
latency_policy.console_feedback_capture_wall_ms: nested inside Voice/control; text capture only, not TTS/acoustic playback
latency_policy.percentiles: linear interpolation across these different clips once each, not a repeated benchmark

limitations: Primary observations decode real WAV bytes with the frozen native ASR; Mock unit tests are separate evidence.
Synthetic audio/signal, public or self-recorded human speech and synthetic transcripts are distinct; missing human home-command recordings stay pending.
Recognizer output includes fixed decoder/hotword search bias; no output-driven retries, selection, reference edits or tuning.
Reference text runs on a new independent Mock through handle_text; it is neither recognized audio nor an automatic retry/fallback of the primary command.
Console feedback is captured synchronously; it is not an audible TTS, acoustic echo or playback latency measurement.
Offline file audio-to-readback wall excludes model load and per-case fixture/setup; live E2E, endpoint ground truth and overflow are unmeasured.
All device states/readbacks are Mock; request acceptance, HA observation and physical completion are not interchangeable.
Observed development cases do not establish general ASR, production safety, real HA, ARM or personal-understanding acceptance.

limits: Official-style schedule using existing fixed factory/model/decoder/hotwords; not an unconditioned model baseline.
Different schedule and tail length together; a changed output cannot isolate either factor.
No state execution or semantic success measurement; diagnostic completion is separate from original closed-loop acceptance.
One observation per fixed synthetic clip; no general model defect, human speech, real devices, ARM or overflow conclusion.

independent_diagnostic.schedule: Entire waveform + 0.66s tail + input_finished, no intermediate endpoint/reset; same model/factory/hotwords. Schedule and tail differ together, not one-factor causal proof.

retention: Paths relative to /home/kxj/zte_ws. Original float/WAV, official source text, test failures, raw ledger/index and independent diagnostic remain ignored local evaluation files; source, cases, small reports and hashes in Git. Exclude generated __pycache__, temporary pre-diagnostic staging duplicates, and this self-index. Model/native identities are in inventories/protocol, not redistributable payloads. Hashes are not backups.

ASR weight license unknown; framework Apache-2.0 is not a weight license.
